Jankmajtis Jewish Cemetery One

Jewish Cemetery · Jánkmajtis, Hungary

Not demolished. NOTE: the source page's community-history narrative for this record was found to describe an entirely different village, Gacsály, word-for-word (population figures, forced labor, deportation route, and even the closing sentence 'The Jewish community of Gacsály has ceased to exist' all reference Gacsály, not Jánkmajtis) - likely another instance of mismatched content between adjacent village pages in the source database. No independent Jánkmajtis-specific history is available from the source; only the structured site-condition data below can be confirmed as genuinely about this location.
